note: Independent rejudge against RFC 2516 Section 5.4 ("The CODE field is set to 0x65 and the SESSION_ID MUST be set to the unique value generated for this PPPoE session."). In 59f67661db, TestRFC2516PADSCarriesTheSessionsID dropped only the removed PppoxFD field from &Session{...} and newAdmittingServer switched from pppoeCreateFn to openSession; all assertions are unchanged. TestRFC2516AdmittedPADSCarriesTheNewSessionsID drives handlePADR for two hosts and asserts each receives PADS CODE 0x65 with a non-zero SESSION_ID matching the session table and bound session transport, and distinct across the two hosts. TestRFC2516PADSCarriesTheSessionsID verifies replay PADS carries CODE 0x65 and the table's SID while BuildPADSError carries 0x0000. TestRFC2516PADSWithZeroSessionIDIsARefusal verifies Host-side tryReadPADS accepts 0x1234 and returns an error with SID 0 on 0x0000. Verdict enforced stands.
